name: immer
description: Create your next immutable state by mutating the current one

scripts.test:perf: cd __performance_tests__ && babel-node add-data.js && babel-node todo.js && babel-node incremental.js
scripts.test:build: yarn build && NODE_ENV='production' yarn jest --config jest.config.build.js
scripts.build: rimraf dist/ && tsdx build --name immer --format esm,cjs,umd && cp dist/immer.esm.js dist/immer.esm.mjs && yarn build:flow
scripts.publish-docs: cd website && GIT_USER=mweststrate USE_SSH=true yarn docusaurus deploy
scripts.test:size: yarn build && yarn import-size --report . produce enableES5 enableMapSet enablePatches enableAllPlugins
scripts.test:sizequick: tsdx build --name immer --format esm && yarn import-size . produce

author: Michel Weststrate
